name: Hsieh Fang-te
bio: Hsieh Fang-te (AD 1226–1289) was a Sung loyalist who refused to serve the Mongol court.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: At His Club
poems.author: Hsieh Fang-te
poems.text:
Long past midnight the wife hears the goatsucker's cry,
And rises to see that the silkworms are fed:
Alas! there's the moon shining low in the sky,
But her husband has not yet come back to his bed.
